name: device-bus-analyzer
description: Read-only access to your Device Bus Analyzer (appliance bus telegrams, findings, timelines) from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Query the telegrams recorded from appliance buses (BSH D-Bus, MACS) by your own Device Bus Analyzer: decoded frames with sender, receiver and ACK node, value timelines, the protocol findings with confirmed / assumed / unknown status, and raw bursts. All tools are read-only and talk only to the analyzer in your network.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Protocol specification with status and evidence

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Program runs grouped from the telegrams

tools.name: command_overview
tools.description: All commands seen on a device

tools.name: frames
tools.description: Decoded telegrams with sender, receiver and ACK node

tools.name: device_state
tools.description: Current taught values of a device

url.title: Analyzer URL
url.description: Address of your Device Bus Analyzer, for example http://192.0.2.10:8089 (no trailing path)

token.title: API token
token.description: The value of API_TOKEN from your stack
